entries.title: lb-tablet migration, licence points and safer evidence handling

changes.text: lb-tablet migration: reports, warrants, citizen and vehicle notes, personal notes, weapons, charges, tags and jail records can now be moved into the MDT with the mdt_migrate console command. It has a dry run, can be run again safely and never writes to lb-tablet's tables
Licence penalty points: every licence on a citizen profile now shows its points, and officers with edit permission can raise or lower them. The points are shared with lb-tablet
Saving an edited report no longer loses its suspects, charges or linked citizens
A licence detail window has been added, showing status, expiry, issuing officer and points. Banning, unbanning and removing a licence are now done from this window
On start, the server console lists every MDT item that is missing from your inventory
Collecting or processing evidence no longer uses up the bag or the evidence when the result item is not defined or the inventory is full
Printing and the forensics lab now say whether the inventory is full or the item is not defined, instead of always reporting a full inventory
Officers now get a notification when they lack permission for an action, instead of the button doing nothing
The CCTV screen filter no longer stays on screen after leaving a camera
If a note fails to save, the editor stays open so the text is not lost
Tags the server refuses no longer appear on reports or citizen profiles
Licences on the citizen profile are now listed in a fixed alphabetical order
The live map can now be zoomed out one step further

entries.title: CCTV, printed reports and department chat
files: editable/config.lua (new CCTV, Chat, PrintedDocument and GlobalAccess sections)

changes.text: CCTV: 586 city cameras can now be watched live from the MDT, with pan, zoom, camera switching and a tour mode. Officers can pin up to 25 cameras, and every camera view is logged

Printed reports: a report can be printed as an inventory item that anyone holding it can read. Includes a print designer (layout, fonts, colour, watermark, signature), public or classified copies, document verification and a copy limit

Department chat: every department gets its own channel, and custom or cross-department channels can be opened. Supports mentions, emoji, report links, location sharing, a typing indicator and an unread counter, and messages can be posted to Discord as digests
A cross-department oversight role (DOJ, FBI, etc.) has been added. It can see and manage every department and can optionally stay hidden from the others
Cameras can be attached to incident reports, with the cameras nearest the incident listed first
Report edit logs now show exactly which fields were changed, both on the Logs page and in Discord
cuffy_phone support has been added, and cylex_phone now shows phone numbers for offline citizens too
A vest slot has been added to the Uniforms page
The Citizens page has been redesigned with photo cards and now shows the total page count
Warrant and BOLO cards have been redesigned to show the photo, time remaining and priority
"Illegal mix of collations" database errors no longer occur on servers whose tables use different collations, including bcs_housing tables
Officers who lose their police job now leave the roster right away, and leftover entries are cleaned up on restart
Vehicles opened from a citizen profile now show their owner and model
Evidence spots can be reached with qb-target again
ESC no longer closes the MDT while a camera feed or a printed document is open
Officers can no longer edit another department's records
ESX: the Citizens list now shows the occupation instead of an ID
A citizen photo that fails to load now shows an icon instead of an empty box
